issues.description: The problem statement specifies that the RGB value is passed in register ECX to set_pixel (and earlier asks to move the pixel value with 'mov ecx, [esi]'). The solution's set_pixel implementation writes EDX to memory (mov [eax], edx) instead of writing ECX. This is a register-parameter mismatch: the solution treats/uses a different register for the color than the specification and template expect. As written the solution will store the wrong value (and/or the high part of a previous mul) into video memory, contradicting the exercise specification and confusing students about which register holds the color.
issues.suggested_fix: In the solution's set_pixel, write the color from ECX into the calculated address instead of EDX. Replace 'mov [eax], edx' with 'mov [eax], ecx' (or otherwise ensure ECX is moved to memory). Verify the function still preserves all registers (except EAX as allowed) by keeping the existing push/pop pairs.
